g.text: Write once, publish to Instagram, Threads and X on autopilot.
Carousels, Reels and Stories planned per platform before approval
Idempotent publishing, so retries never double-post
Auto-refreshes Meta tokens; runs on Docker, GitHub Actions or Azure
